database_domain.cutover_rule: fresh encrypted R2 restore point, stop all DB clients then PostgreSQL, checkpoint/clean shutdown, exact offline copy, mapper-backed external volume, start PostgreSQL then reconciler then application services, retain old source read-only

operations_domain.cutover_rule: prefer empty/reconciled encrypted Redis state over copying stale operational queues; move retained sanitized non-container logs or make them volatile before claiming coverage

local_backup_domain.cutover_rule: stop backup writer, exact manifest copy, switch backend read-only and backup-worker read-write mounts, retain legacy source read-only until an encrypted backup plus restore succeeds from the new vault

container_runtime_domain.reason: containerd uses about 398.6 GB while the root had about 322 GB free, so a duplicate retained copy cannot meet rollback and free-space safety simultaneously
container_runtime_domain.selected_path: clean encrypted runtime reconstruction from pinned images and exact protected source, not copying historical containerd layers/build cache
requirements_before_cutover: database, Redis, backup and authoritative named volumes already externalized to encrypted domain vaults
all active images either pinned/pullable or rebuilt from exact protected source
rebuild images for the five currently running services whose image metadata was previously pruned
wipe/rebuild npm, security-tool and Ollama caches from pinned authorities
independent fresh candidate runtime acceptance before retiring historical containerd store
Docker and containerd remain stopped if the runtime mapper is unavailable

host_state_domain.bootstrap_reason: the MCP control tunnel must return before encrypted application vaults are unlocked; its minimal control-plane bootstrap credential cannot depend on host-state-vault in the current no-TPM/no-KMS design
host_state_domain.cutover_rule: move application/provider/operator secrets and retained audit/release state behind mapper-backed or bind-mounted encrypted paths, preserving only the explicitly reviewed management bootstrap needed for out-of-band unlock

swap.selected_path: random-key encrypted swap regenerated each boot; no persistent recovery key

temporary_data.policy: sensitive runtime staging must move to /run or /dev/shm; /tmp and /var/tmp may retain only classified nonsensitive rebuildable artifacts

project_npm_cache.action: wipe and rebuild from package lock/pinned registries

security_tool_cache.action: wipe and rebuild; authoritative user source/remediation already lives in FR-06B encrypted roots

ollama_model_cache.action: wipe and rebuild from pinned model authority

required_order: FR-06C2 database-vault isolated migration/recovery lab then production cutover
FR-06C3 local-backup-vault and Redis/operations handling with independent rollback
FR-06C4 rebuildable cache wipe/rebuild and clean container-runtime-vault reconstruction
FR-06C5 host-state secret/audit/release migration plus random-key encrypted swap and temporary-data controls
FR-06C6 real host reboot and independent recovery acceptance with all seven vault domains, then FR-06 parent closure
release_boundary: FR-06 remains open. This inventory is read-only and does not authorize any FR-06C production data movement.
